items.title: Jensen Huang admits an affair with an alleged Chinese spy; memes
items.summary: Huang told staff he had been unfaithful after reports that US intelligence believes the woman, a former tech executive, was recruited by Chinese intelligence; China called it a smear. X piled on with jokes, and Nvidia fell 4.3%.
items.author: @FT

post.name: Financial Times
post.text: Breaking news: Nvidia’s chief executive Jensen Huang has admitted having an affair two days after the FT reported his alleged romantic relationship with a woman the US intelligence community believes was working as a spy for China. ft.trib.al/kQjw5UV
